help.stdout:
usage: gnd fidelity [-h] --cases CASES --artifacts ARTIFACTS [--out OUT]
                    [--format {text,json}]
                    model

Measure the EXTRACTOR, per fact type, over committed case directories. This
command emits RATES and never a per-run verdict — it is the dual of `gnd
verify`, which emits verdicts and never a rate: a checker pass over an
uncalibrated extraction is not evidence of faithfulness. Matching is by the
model's own reference scheme under a LEXICAL-only normalization, multiset (tp
per identity key is min(source_count, extracted_count)), with INCLUSIVE
precision (unresolved and ambiguous extractions stay in the denominator) and
`ambiguous` as an explicit outcome for normalization collisions and broken
composite identities — never an arbitrary match. Every rate ships with its
numerator AND denominator, no figure blends fact types, and the payload is
schema-REQUIRED to report calibration.state 'uncalibrated' and publishable
false: the round trip measures the round trip, and while the calibration set
is deferred no interval field may exist at all. Fully offline over committed
artifacts. Exits 0 with the report, 3 on a digest binding mismatch inside a
case, 64 on usage errors or a case set spanning more than one model, 66 when a
required extraction artifact is missing (fail closed — a missing applicable
set must not read as coverage), 70 on an internal contract breach, 74 when the
output path is refused.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cases CASES         directory of case directories, each carrying
                        source.population.json, document.md,
                        document.manifest.json, extracted.population.json and
                        extracted.population.extraction.json (or
                        extraction.skipped.json)
  --artifacts ARTIFACTS
                        the gnd extract bundle directory holding
                        <stem>.applicable.json
  --out OUT             write the payload to this path
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
